expectations.text: Every generated CLAUDE.md contains exactly one `<!-- wiki-managed: start -->` and one `<!-- wiki-managed: end -->` marker (grep -c returns 1 for each on every file)
expectations.evidence: grep -c on root + 3 submodule CLAUDE.md files: each returns start=1 end=1 (4/4 files).

expectations.text: Root CLAUDE.md lists EXACTLY three submodule links — one per discovered submodule — with relative paths that resolve to real CLAUDE.md files under the submodule dirs
expectations.evidence: Root contains exactly 3 lines matching `[name](name/CLAUDE.md)` for backend, frontend, shared; each target file exists at the resolved relative path.

expectations.text: Each submodule CLAUDE.md contains a relative link back to the root CLAUDE.md (e.g., `../../CLAUDE.md`) under a Parent Project heading, and the link target resolves
expectations.evidence: frontend/, backend/, shared/ each have a `## Parent Project` heading followed by `[Root CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md)`; readlink -f resolves all three to the actual root CLAUDE.md (depth-1 submodules use `../`, matching generator logic).

expectations.text: Managed section content is non-empty: each file's region between the start/end markers contains at least an Overview heading OR a non-empty link to wiki/index.md — empty markers fail
expectations.evidence: All 4 files contain `## Overview` AND a `wiki/index.md` link inside the managed region.

expectations.text: Running the generator a second time produces byte-identical CLAUDE.md files across the board (diff -ru is empty) — idempotency holds
expectations.evidence: Snapshotted all 4 files, re-ran 4 generations, diff -q on each pair reported MATCH; no byte differences.

expectations.text: When the user edits content OUTSIDE the managed markers between runs (e.g., adds a new heading above the start marker), the next generation preserves that edit unchanged
expectations.evidence: Added a manual header before the start marker and a manual footer after the end marker on root CLAUDE.md, re-ran generator. sha256 of pre-marker bytes: 0a709f6c…2304 (identical before/after). sha256 of post-marker bytes: 74eea628…3a28 (identical before/after).

eval_feedback.overall: All 6 expectations pass. Generator produces correct root + 3 submodule CLAUDE.md files with balanced markers, parent links resolve, idempotency and outside-marker preservation both hold across re-runs.
